title: The waiting page gets its final look, in every repo at once
why: Your worry, Oct 26: "is it already too late to decide the look ... I realize i allowed a beta to be the final product". It is not too late: every repo's page comes from one template, skills/waiting-page/page.html.
note: Under way (coordinator, Oct 26): five Opus mockup threads redesign the page, three seeded with the current pilot and two blind (mockups in plans/waiting-mockups/ in project files). You pick a look; it replaces skills/waiting-page/page.html; home-app's page and the pilot are republished from it, and every later page follows. Rides with c74 (list what Accept every pick saves) and c99 (a save gets a reply). Port: yes, through the skill. Placed after c99, ahead of c72 (triage, Oct 27).
